pages.title: A Fine Cut
pages.text: Collect the result of a real Chopping Board cutting recipe.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Place food on the board and use a Kitchen Knife. Fat from suitable knife-killed animals opens an oil route, but killing a pet is not required.

pages.title: Prepare meat and fat
pages.text: A Chopping Board and Kitchen Knife prepare ingredients. Native fat drops from suitable animals are one possible route to cooking oil.
